section_header: SUSPENSION AND AXLE — FRONT AXLE HUB
title: STEERING KNUCKLE WITH AXLE HUB REMOVAL
ocr_text:
SA–16
SUSPENSION AND AXLE  –  FRONT AXLE HUB

STEERING KNUCKLE WITH AXLE HUB
REMOVAL

Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
INSTALLATION HINT: After installation, check ABS speed
sensor signal and front wheel alignment.
(See page BR–62 and SA–4)

1. REMOVE FRONT WHEEL
Torque: 103 N·m (1,050 kgf·cm, 96 ft·lbf)

2. REMOVE FRONT BRAKE CALIPER AND DISC
(a) Remove the 2 bolts and brake caliper from the steering
knuckle.
Torque: 118 N·m (1,200 kgf·cm, 87 ft·lbf)
(b) Support the brake caliper securely.
(c) Place matchmarks on the disc and axle hub.
(d) Remove the disc.

R06918

3. CHECK BACKLASH IN BEARING SHAFT DIRECTION
Place the dial indicator near the center of the axle hub and
check the backlash in the bearing shaft direction.
Maximum:
0.05 mm (0.0020 in.)
If greater than the specified maximum, replace the bearing.

R06920

4. CHECK AXLE HUB DEVIATION
Using a dial indicator, check the deviation at the surface of
the axle hub outside the hub bolt.
Maximum:
0.05 mm (0.0020 in.)
If greater than the specified maximum, replace the axle hub.

R06921

5. DISCONNECT ABS SPEED SENSOR FROM STEERING
KNUCKLE
Remove the bolt and disconnect the sensor from the steering
knuckle.
Torque: 8 N·m (80 kgf·cm, 69 in·lbf)

R07238
